immutableTechnicalConstraints: Preserve native editable 3D stool, actual legs/support/cushion construction, authored height and proportions, footprint [1,1], ground root and seat socket [0,0,0.685].

Preserve registered camera projection, pixel aspect, world scale, logical frame [192,352], root [96,248], sourceScale 2 and 384x704 native delivered frame; no per-view fit, recoloring, raster card, or target-image registration substitution.
Deliver N/E/S/W independent native static facings, one frame each, 12 fps metadata and non-looping/static behavior; required four-view and repeated previews use the same capture.
Soft horizontally neutral world lighting across all directions; no directional ground cast shadow or added backing plane.

aestheticCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Seat reads as a padded rounded-square blue cushion with broad continuous surface variation and gently softened edge transitions; preserve seat size, native construction and usable attachment height. Legs and crossbar remain recognizable structural pieces.
failureExamples: Large perfectly uniform flat top with hard stepped rim bands
Over-inflated seat that changes the native footprint, height or contact
Blobby legs or merged supports that obscure stool construction

aestheticCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Retain a saturated blue cushion and warm honey wood legs/supports, with color variation that feels softly lit and friendly. Wood remains bright enough to read down to the feet; cushion blue remains distinct from wood.
failureExamples: Electric cyan flat panel separated by harsh royal-blue strips
Gray/brown muddy supports or palette change away from blue-and-honey-wood identity

aestheticCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Broad low-contrast highlights and gentle occlusion describe the cushion, legs and support joints. Keep horizontal symmetry; each facing belongs to one scene and lighting scheme.
failureExamples: Blown white/glassy spots or hard highlight stripes
Crushed dark joints, underside or feet

aestheticCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Cushion and wood feel softly tactile with restrained roughness and optional subtle coherent grain or fabric variation. Prioritize clean large forms and readable edges over target microtexture.
failureExamples: Noisy speckles or strong procedural bands visible at logical size
Abrupt normal seams or coplanar flicker

aestheticCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: All four static facings remain clean and legible at 192x352 logical frame size as well as native enlargement. No material dead spots: opaque black patches, broken corners, clipped geometry, merged supports, exposed ends, seams or unwanted fringe. Clean transparency on light, neutral and dark backgrounds.
failureExamples: Dark gap incorrectly filled by opaque background
Lost wood leg or support at use size

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: The large cushion reads as softly padded blue volume at catalog scale, using continuous gentle shading and rounded edge transitions while preserving the authored envelope and seat attachment.
Wooden legs and supports read as warm honey wood with clear construction and readable lower faces; remove the original almost-black lower-leg dead areas without flattening contact depth.

Unify all four native facings with broad soft highlights, restrained material variation and clean alpha; no directional horizontal light preference, cast ground shadow, harsh stripes, halo, seams or merged joints.

nonRequirements: Target canvas, padding, scale and placement changes
Target inflated silhouette or changed proportions
Exact target pixel match or surface microtexture
Invented unseen-facing geometry from the single-view target
approvalEvidence: Hash-bound immutable candidate packet and exact native render bytes for all four required facings plus declared previews.
Native camera/root/footprint/seat-socket/height/geometry/lighting validation and editable scene evidence.
Direct visual inspection of each facing at logical size and enlargement on suitable backgrounds; passing contract plus visible improvement toward frozen style criteria.
